versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Lemmings where only the one in front has working text; each death passes the lead and a shared Banner buff to the next.
You order the herd so the right leader speaks while recruiting and in each moment of the fight.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Settled the rules questions: Herding Council and Snow Hall Digger are now Loud (work from any slot), two Fronts each carry the Banner, Gerd reaches a back-row Front, doubled swaps happen once, and Stitcher and Old Mother Lemen say exactly when and what they copy.
Tally became a non-Lemming fox so the early economy needs no Front swap; the core rule and every bold card stay as they were.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Settled the last two unclear cards: Herald copies only printed text and skips Heralds, and Old Mother Lemen's Kits copy her full Health, take their own damage, and can never be your Front while she lives.
Kit-Minder became Loud and Ole fills only slots after itself, so neither fights the End of Turn spot or steals the lead; The Front Lemming reads in shorter sentences.
